report.answer_text: The Mississippi River ranges from 20–30 feet wide at its source at Lake Itasca, Minnesota, to more than 11 miles wide where it passes through Lake Winnibigoshish, also in Minnesota. Its widest navigable stretch is about 2 miles wide at Lake Pepin, on the Minnesota–Wisconsin border. (nps.gov)
